			visible = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
					has_free_market_bonus_max = yes
					has_moderate_free_market_bonus = yes
					has_socialist_free_market_bonus = yes
					check_variable = { economic_x_axis > 10 }
					check_variable = { economic_x_axis = 10 }
				}
				}
				has_country_flag = cwic_allows_foreign_concessions
			}
			available = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { CWIC_nationalization_pressure_index > 4.5 } }
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_variable = corp_bp_presence_hydrocarbons }
					check_variable = { corp_bp_presence_hydrocarbons < 5 }
				}
				NOT = { has_country_flag = cwic_invite_cd_bp_hydrocarbons }
			}
			cost = 50
			removal_cost = 0
			picture = generic_refining_concern_1
			on_add = {
				set_variable = { cwic_invite_bp_hydrocarbons = 84 } # months
				set_country_flag = cwic_has_pending_mnc_invite
				set_country_flag = { flag = cwic_invite_cd_bp_hydrocarbons days = 180 value = 1 }
			}
			ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		}
